revised_prompt:
Recreate the party scene from the first reference image, preserving the same seven cute food characters and their actions, but compose it with the much wider, higher, farther-back camera framing of the second reference image. Vertical frame, camera about 45 degrees above the table. Show one single big round dark iron Chongqing hotpot with no dividers, almost completely visible, about 85-90% of the pot visible, round rim and both side handles visible. The pot should occupy about 80% of the frame width in the lower-middle of the image. Surround it with a wooden table, small bowls of dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns, and a softly blurred lantern-lit Chongqing restaurant background above.

Inside the pot: glossy deep-red chili oil broth at a rolling boil, many big translucent orange-red bubbles, rising steam, glistening oil highlights, floating dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns. Keep exactly these character/action beats from the first reference: one chili character surfing on top of a big bubble with arms spread, laughing; three tiny Sichuan peppercorn characters bouncing high in the air off a bursting bubble; one chili character floating on its back doing backstroke; two chili characters giving each other a high five with an oil splash. Characters should be spread across the pot but large enough that all faces are readable.

Character design must match the first reference: googly eyes with white eyeballs and black pupils, small simple mouths with no teeth, tiny arms and legs made from their own chili or peppercorn material, realistic wrinkled glossy dried chili textures and bumpy Sichuan peppercorn textures. Photorealistic cute food-character animation style, warm tungsten restaurant lighting, appetizing, cinematic depth of field, subtle film grain.

Strict exclusions: no humans, no utensils in the pot, no text, no logos, no transparent background, no cutouts, no black corner areas. The background must be fully opaque and fill the entire image edge to edge with restaurant/table environment.
